fields.label: Background
fields.content: By terms of the 1960 Treaty of Establishment that created the independent Republic of Cyprus, the UK retained full sovereignty and jurisdiction over two areas of almost 254 square kilometers - Akrotiri and Dhekelia. The larger of these is the Dhekelia Sovereign Base Area, which is also referred to as the Eastern Sovereign Base Area.

fields.label: Location
fields.content: on the southeast coast of Cyprus near Famagusta

fields.label: Map references
fields.content: Middle East

fields.label: Area
fields.content:
total: 130.8 sq km

note: area surrounds three Cypriot enclaves

fields.label: Area - comparative
fields.content: about three-quarters the size of Washington, DC

fields.label: Land boundaries
fields.content: total: NA

fields.label: Climate
fields.content: temperate; Mediterranean with hot, dry summers and cool winters

fields.label: Environment - current issues
fields.content: netting and trapping of small migrant songbirds in the spring and autumn

fields.label: Geography - note
fields.content: British extraterritorial rights also extended to several small off-post sites scattered across Cyprus

fields.label: Population
fields.content:
no indigenous personnel

note: approximately 2,200 resident military personnel; there are another 5,000 British citizens who are families of military personnel or civilian staff on both the bases of Akrotiri and Dhekelia; Cyprus citizens work on the base but do not live there

fields.label: Languages
fields.content: English, Greek

fields.label: Country name
fields.content:
conventional long form: Dhekelia Sovereign Base Area

conventional short form: Dhekelia

fields.label: Dependency status
fields.content: overseas territory of UK; administered by an administrator who is also the Commander, British Forces Cyprus

fields.label: Capital
fields.content:
name: Episkopi Cantonment; located in Akrotiri

geographic coordinates: 34 40 N, 32 51 E

time difference: UTC+2 (7 hours ahead of Washington, DC during Standard Time)

daylight saving time: +1hr, begins last Sunday in March; ends last Sunday in October

fields.label: Constitution
fields.content: Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia Order in Council 1960, effective 16 August 1960

fields.label: Legal system
fields.content: the Sovereign Base Area Administration has its own court system to deal with civil and criminal matters; laws applicable to the Cypriot population are, as far as possible, the same as the laws of the Republic of Cyprus

fields.label: Executive branch
fields.content:
chief of state: Queen ELIZABETH II (since 6 February 1952)

head of government: Administrator Air Vice-Marshal Richard LACEY (since 26 April 2006); note - reports to the British Ministry of Defense

elections: none; the monarch is hereditary; the administrator is appointed by the monarch

fields.label: Diplomatic representation in the US
fields.content: none (overseas territory of the UK)

fields.label: Diplomatic representation from the US
fields.content: none (overseas territory of the UK)

fields.label: Flag description
fields.content: the flag of the UK is used

fields.label: Economy - overview
fields.content: Economic activity is limited to providing services to the military and their families located in Dhekelia. All food and manufactured goods must be imported.

fields.label: Industries
fields.content: none

fields.label: Currency (code)
fields.content: Cypriot pound (CYP)

fields.label: Radio broadcast stations
fields.content: AM NA, FM 1 (located in Akrotiri), shortwave NA (British Forces Broadcasting Service (BFBS) provides Radio 1 and Radio 2 service to Akrotiri, Dhekelia, and Nicosia) (2006)

fields.label: Television broadcast stations
fields.content: 0 (British Forces Broadcasting Service (BFBS) provides multi-channel satellite service to Akrotiri, Dhekelia, and Nicosia) (2006)

fields.label: Military - note
fields.content:
includes Dhekelia Garrison and Ayios Nikolaos Station connected by a roadway
